correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=2, a directed cycle in K_{2,n} occurs exactly when both mixed column types occur. Inclusion-exclusion yields Z=2*3^n-2^n, and explicitly marked columns give c=(3^(n-1)-2^(n-1))/(2Z), d=3^(n-2)/(2Z). The identity c+6d=1/4 yields symmetric eigenvalue 1/4+c, antisymmetric contrast eigenvalue 4d and common-mode eigenvalue 2(n+2)d, all positive. Direct inversion gives all Q entries; convexity of reciprocals proves the nontrivial negative same-column off-diagonal sign. Exact graph-acyclicity enumeration and rational verification across n=2..8 passed 90,094 assertions. Finite computation is corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: This solves a mathematically explicit edge-direction correlation question for an infinite family of uniform acyclic orientations, with a complete spectrum and precision entries controlling every linear score and full-order adjusted pair. Persistent cross-column marginal correlations (+/-1/9) coexist with disappearing partial correlations (signed 3/(4n)); the structure is not captured by total poly-Bernoulli counts or by an arbitrary isolated finite statistic. The exact n>=2 boundary and all sign classes are natural, not arbitrary slices.
